texts.en:
£megastructure£ Megastructures are colossal projects that we can [GetBuildGrow] out in the void of space. They may provide us with cutting-edge research facilities, access to superior resources, or even some unique forms of transportation.

Building on such a scale requires a significant investment of time and resources, but the rewards are every bit as sizable. We can get under way by setting a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship to this task.
